answer: Give every agent identity a lease that only renews through unannounced, randomized liveness challenges tied to its unique execution fingerprint: an agent must solve a fresh puzzle within a short window, like a lotus opening only at dawn, proving one live machine sits behind one identity. Miss the window and the lease fades to an umber ember; renew it and your trust horizon stretches further. A sybil attacker must run real hardware for every fake around the clock, so a thousand identities cost a thousand machines, while an honest agent answers one quick check and keeps working.
